script_text: Pisces — Neptune stations direct this week, and the Universe is handing you a mirror you cannot ignore. Early Monday through Wednesday, the Sun squares your ruling planet Neptune in the 12th House, creating fog around decisions — trust your intuition over logic during this intense Water sign period. Thursday's mid-week turning point arrives when the Moon enters your 7th House of partnerships, sextile Venus — expect a vulnerable conversation that shifts everything. Late week, Mars conjunct Jupiter in your 10th House fires up career ambitions; a money opportunity surfaces Friday that could change your income structure. Saturday's full Moon in Pisces illuminates your 5th House — love blooms unexpectedly Wednesday when Venus trines Neptune, but avoid drama Sunday when Mercury squares Neptune. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury trines Neptune at 4° Virgo, sharpening communication. Avoid impulsive purchases Monday — the 2nd House faces challenging square energy. Follow for daily updates.
